name: Headscale
summary: Open-source, self-hosted implementation of the Tailscale control server: install, configuration (config.yaml), ACL/grants policy, OIDC, DERP, DNS, routes and exit nodes, tags, connecting clients, REST API.
coverage: All English docs at tag v0.29.7 (the MkDocs source of headscale.net), the example server and DERP configs, the REST API (Swagger 2) spec with generated pages, and the 0.29.x changelog.
gaps: No CLI reference page exists in the docs; run `headscale --help` / `headscale <command> --help`. CLI changes are in the changelog.
Tailscale client and policy-syntax docs are not included (they live on tailscale.com); Headscale's policy page links to them.
notes: Latest stable release on 2026-11-10: v0.29.7 (GitHub releases). Build-time handling: `{{ headscale.version }}` (MkDocs macros) replaced 6 times in ref/configuration.md with 0.29.5, the value mkdocs.yml `extra.headscale.version` holds at tag v0.29.7 (the site shows 0.29.5 although the release is 0.29.7); about/contributing.md's `include-markdown "../../CONTRIBUTING.md"` inlined from the same tag. Added config-example.yaml and derp-example.yaml, which ref/configuration.md and ref/derp.md point to. API pages generated with --version 0.29.7 because the spec says 'version not set'.
